Supercharge your Android development with 6 expert tips for Gemini in Android Studio
用6个专家建议在Android Studio中为Gemini强化你的Android开发

Share this post LinkedIn Twitter Facebook Email Copy link


Posted by Trevor Johns, Developer Relations Engineer 作者：Trevor Johns，开发者关系工程师









In January we announced Android Studio Otter 3 Feature Drop in stable, including Agent Mode enhancements and many other updates to provide more control and flexibility over using AI to help you build high quality Android apps. To help you get the most out of Gemini in Android Studio and all the new capabilities, we sat down with Google engineers and Google Developer Experts to gather their best practices for working with the latest features—including Agent mode and the New Project Assistant. Here are some useful insights to help you get the best out of your development:
今年一月，我们宣布Android Studio Otter 3功能将以稳定版形式发布，包括代理模式的增强以及许多其他更新，旨在提供更多控制和灵活性，帮助你使用AI构建高质量的Android应用。为了帮助你充分发挥 Gemini 在 Android Studio 中的优势和所有新功能，我们与谷歌工程师和开发者专家坐下来，收集他们在使用最新功能（包括代理模式和新项目助理）方面的最佳实践。以下是一些有用的见解，帮助你充分发挥开发效果：



  1. Build apps from scratch with the New Project Assistant 用New Project Assistant从零开始构建应用


The new Project Assistant—now available in the latest Canary builds—integrates Gemini with the Studio's New Project wizard. By simply providing prompts and (optionally) design mockups, you can generate entire applications from scratch, including scaffolding, architecture, and Jetpack Compose layouts. 最新的 Project Assistant——现已在最新的 Canary 版本中提供——将 Gemini 与 Studio 的新项目向导集成。只需提供提示和（可选）设计模型，你就能从零生成完整的应用程序，包括脚手架、架构和Jetpack Compose布局。


Integrated with the Android Emulator, it can deploy your build and "walk through" the app, making sure it’s functioning correctly and that the rendered screens actually match your vision. Additionally, you can use Agent Mode to then continue to work on the app and iterate, leveraging Gemini to refine your app to fit your vision. 它与Android模拟器集成，可以部署你的构建并“走遍”应用，确保它正常运行，渲染的屏幕是否符合你的设想。此外，您还可以使用代理模式继续开发和迭代应用，利用 Gemini 优化应用以符合您的愿景。


Also, while this feature works with the default (no-cost) model, we highly recommend using this feature with an AI Studio API Key to access the latest models — like Gemini 3.1 Pro or 3.0 Flash — which excel at agentic workflows. Additionally, adding your API Key allows the New Project Assistant to use Nano Banana behind the scenes to help with ideating on UI design, improving the visual fidelity of the generated application! - Trevor Johns, Developer Relations Engineer. 此外，虽然此功能适用于默认（免费）型号，但我们强烈建议将此功能与 AI Studio API Key 一起使用，以访问最新型号——如 Gemini 3.1 Pro 或 3.0 Flash——它们在代理式工作流方面表现出色。此外，添加您的API密钥后，新项目助理可以在幕后使用Nano Banana协助设计UI，提升生成应用的视觉真实度！- Trevor Johns，开发者关系工程师。


Dialog for setting up a new project. 用于建立新项目的对话框。


2. Ask the Agent to refine your code by providing it with ‘intentional’ contexts 2. 要求代理通过提供“有意”上下文来完善你的代码


When using Gemini Agents, the quality of the output is directly tied to the boundaries you set. Don't just ask it to "fix this code"— be very intentional with the context that you provide it and be specific about what you want (and what you don't). Improve the output by providing recent blogs or docs so the model can make accurate suggestions based on these. 使用Gemini代理时，输出质量直接与你设定的边界挂钩。不要只是让它“修正这段代码”——要非常有意识地提供上下文，明确说明你想要什么（和不想要什么）。通过提供近期的博客或文档来提升输出，使模型能够基于这些内容做出准确的建议。


Ask the Agent to simplify complex logic, or if it see’s any fundamental problems with it, or even ask it to scan for security risks in areas where you feel uncertain. Being firm with your instructions—even telling the model "please do not invent things" in instances where you are using very new or experimental APIs—helps keep the AI focused on the outputs you are trying to achieve. - Alejandra Stamato, Android Google Developer Expert and Android Engineer at HubSpot. 让代理简化复杂的逻辑，或者如果它发现了根本性的问题，甚至让它扫描你感到不确定的安全风险。坚定地执行指令——甚至在使用非常新或实验性的API时告诉模型“请不要发明东西”——有助于让AI专注于你想要实现的输出。- Alejandra Stamato，HubSpot的Android谷歌开发者专家及Android工程师。


3. Use documentation with Agent mode to provide context for new libraries 3. 使用代理模式的文档为新库提供上下文


To prevent the model from hallucinating code for niche or brand-new libraries, leverage Android Studio’s Agent tools, to have access to documentation: Search Android Docs and Fetch Android Docs. You can direct Gemini to search the Android Knowledge Base or specific documentation articles. The model can choose to use this if it thinks it’s missing some information, which is good especially when you use niche API’s, or one’s which aren’t as common.  为了防止模型产生针对小众或全新库的代码幻觉，请利用Android Studio的代理工具访问文档：搜索Android文档并获取Android文档。你可以让 Gemini 搜索 Android 知识库或特定文档文章。模型如果认为缺少某些信息，可以选择使用它，这在使用细分API或不常见API时尤其好。


If you are certain you want the model to consult the documentation and to make sure those tools are triggered, a good trick is to add something like ‘search the official documentation’ or ‘check the docs’ to your prompts. And for documentation on different libraries which aren’t Android specific, install a MCP Server that lets you access documentation like Context7 (or something similar). - Jose Alcérreca, Android Developer Relations Engineer, Google. 如果你确定想让模型查阅文档并确保这些工具被触发，一个好方法是在提示中添加“搜索官方文档”或“检查文档”这样的内容。对于非Android专用库的文档，安装一个MCP服务器，允许你访问像Context7（或类似软件）这样的文档。- Jose Alcérreca，谷歌Android开发者关系工程师。


4. Use AI to help build Agents.md files for using custom frameworks, libraries and design systems 4. 利用人工智能帮助构建 Agents.md 文件，用于使用自定义框架、库和设计系统


To make sure Agent uses custom frameworks, libraries and design systems you have two options 1) In settings, Android Studio allows you to specify rules to be followed when Gemini is performing these actions for you. Or 2) Create Agents.md files in your application and specify how things should be done or act as guidance for when AI is performing a task, specific frameworks, design systems, or specific ways of doing things (such as the exact architecture, things to do or what not to do), in a standard bullet point way to give AI clear instructions.  为了确保Agent使用自定义框架、库和设计系统，你有两个选择：1）在设置中，Android Studio允许你指定Gemini执行这些作时需要遵守的规则。或者2）在你的应用中创建 Agents.md 文件，明确说明AI执行任务时的作方式，具体框架、设计系统或具体作方式（比如具体架构、需要做的事情或不该做什么），用标准条式条式的方式给AI明确的指令。


Manage AGENTS.md files as context. 把 AGENTS.md 文件当作上下文管理。


You can also use Agents.md file at the root of the project, and can have them in different modules (or even subdirectories) of your project as well! The more context you have or the more guidance available when you’re working, that will be available for AI to access. If you get stuck creating these Agents.md files you can use AI to help build them, or give you foundations based on the projects you have and then edit them so you don’t have to start from scratch. - Joe Birch, Android Google Developer Expert and Staff Engineer at Buffer. 你也可以在项目根使用 Agents.md 文件，并且可以将它们放在项目的不同模块（甚至子目录）中！你工作时掌握的上下文越多，或者指导越多，AI就能访问这些信息。如果你卡在创建这些 Agents.md 文件上，可以用AI帮忙构建，或者根据现有项目打好基础，然后编辑它们，这样就不用从头开始。- Joe Birch，Android Google 开发者专家，Buffer 的员工工程师。


5. Offload the tedious tasks to Agent and save yourself time 5. 把繁琐的任务交给特工，节省时间


You can get Gemini in Android Studio agent to help you make tasks such as writing and reviewing faster. For example it can help writing commit messages, giving you a good summary which you can then review and save yourself time. Additionally, get it to write tests; under your direction the Agent can look at the other tests in your project and write a good test for you to run following best practices just by looking at them. Another good example of a tedious task is writing a new parser for a certain JSON format. Just give Gemini a few examples and it will get you started very quickly. - Diego Perez, Android Software Engineer, Google  你可以在Android Studio里用Gemini Agent，帮你加快写作和复习等任务。例如，它可以帮助写出承诺信息，给你一个好的总结，你可以在阅读时节省时间。另外，让它写测试;在您的指导下，代理可以查看项目中的其他测试，仅凭观察就能为你编写出符合最佳实践的好测试。另一个繁琐任务的好例子是为某个JSON格式写一个新的解析器。只要给双子座举几个例子，就能很快帮你起步。- 迭戈·佩雷斯，谷歌安卓软件工程师


6. Control what you are sharing with AI using simple opt-outs or commands, alongside paid models. 6. 通过简单的退出或命令控制你与AI分享的内容，配合付费模型。


If you want to control what is shared with AI whilst on the no-cost plans, you can opt out some or all your code from model training by adding an AI exclusions file (‘.aiexclude’) to your project. This file uses glob pattern matching similar to a .gitignore file, specifying sensitive directories or files that should be hidden from the AI. You can place .aiexclude files anywhere within the project and its VCS roots to control which files AI features are allowed to access. 如果你想控制在免费套餐下与AI共享的内容，可以通过在项目中添加AI排除文件（“.aiexclude”）来选择退出部分或全部代码。该文件使用类似于 .gitignore 文件的 glob 模式匹配，指定敏感目录或应对 AI 隐藏的文件。你可以在项目及其 VCS 根中任意放置 .aiexclude 文件，以控制 AI 功能允许访问哪些文件。


An example of an `.aiexclude` file in Android Studio. Android Studio 中一个“.aiexclude” 文件的示例。


Alternatively, in Android Studio settings, you can also opt out of context sharing either on a per project or per user basis (although this method limits the functionality of a number of features because the AI won’t see your code). 另外，在 Android Studio 设置中，你也可以选择按项目或按用户选择退出上下文共享（尽管这种方式会限制部分功能，因为 AI 不会看到你的代码）。


Remember, paid plans never use your code for model training. This includes both users using an AI Studio API Key, and businesses who are subscribed to Gemini Code Assist. - Trevor Johns, Developer Relations Engineer. 记住，付费套餐绝不会用你的代码进行模型训练。这包括使用 AI Studio API Key 的用户，以及订阅 Gemini Code Assist 的企业。- Trevor Johns，开发者关系工程师。


Hear more from the Android team and Google Developer Experts about Gemini in Android Studio in our recent fireside chat and download Android Studio to get started. 在我们最近的炉边谈话中，听听Android团队和谷歌开发者专家关于Android Studio中Gemini的更多信息，并下载Android Studio以开始使用。
